shape-cropper.name: Shape Cropper
shape-cropper.metaTitle: Shape Cropper - Crop Photos Into Shapes | JaurTools
shape-cropper.metaDescription: Crop photos into circles, stars, hexagons and more with transparent or colored backgrounds. Free online.
shape-cropper.keywords: clip image to shape, circle crop photo, star shape photo, hexagon image crop, photo shape cutter
shape-cropper.quickAnswer: Upload a photo, pick a shape — circle, rounded square, triangle, hexagon, star, or diamond — and the tool center-crops your photo to a square, clips it to the shape, and downloads a transparent PNG. A 1200 x 800 photo becomes a 800 x 800 clipped image using the middle 800 px. Choose a white or black background instead of transparency if you prefer.
keyFacts: Six shapes: circle, rounded square, triangle, hexagon, star, diamond.
Your photo is center-cropped to a square first, so the shape is always balanced.
Transparent background is the default — perfect for logos and stickers.
White or black background options for documents and profile pictures.
The star uses true 5-point geometry; the hexagon is a regular flat-top hexagon.
Output PNG preserves transparency and sharp shape edges.
howTo: Upload a photo (JPG, PNG, or WebP).
Pick one of the six shapes.
Choose transparent, white, or black background.
Check the live preview — the shape always uses the photo's center.
Click Download to save the clipped image as PNG.
shape-cropper.formula:
Square side S = min(photoWidth, photoHeight).
Crop window: x = (photoWidth - S) / 2, y = (photoHeight - S) / 2.
The shape path is drawn inside the S x S square, then the photo is painted through it.
Example: 1200 x 800 -> S = 800, window x = 200, y = 0.
shape-cropper.workedExample:
Photo 1200 x 800, circle shape, transparent background:
1. S = min(1200, 800) = 800.
2. Crop window: x = (1200-800)/2 = 200, y = 0 — the middle 800 x 800 region.
3. A circle of diameter 800 is drawn centered at (400, 400) of that square.
4. Result: 800 x 800 PNG — your photo visible inside the circle, transparent corners.
benefits: Profile pictures and avatars in perfect circles without an editor.
Transparent PNGs drop straight into slides, docs, and designs.
Star and hexagon shapes make thumbnails and badges stand out.
Center-crop logic keeps faces centered automatically.
No uploads — personal photos stay on your device.
limitations: The crop always uses the photo center — you cannot pan the crop window.
Shapes are fixed proportions; no custom polygons or freehand paths.
Output is square — wide banners cannot be clipped.
Anti-aliased edges look smooth on screen but may show a faint halo on busy backgrounds.
shape-cropper.privacyNote: This tool runs 100% in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.q: Will the background really be transparent?
faqs.a: Yes, when you pick the transparent option. The PNG keeps a true alpha channel, so it composites cleanly over any background in slides, websites, or design tools.

faqs.q: Why is my face cut off?
faqs.a: The tool center-crops the photo to a square before clipping. If your subject sits near an edge, crop the photo closer to the subject first in any editor, then clip it here.

faqs.q: Can I clip to a heart or custom shape?
faqs.a: Not in this version — the six built-in shapes cover the most common needs. Custom SVG path upload is on the wishlist for a future update.
The output is square with side equal to your photo's shorter side — an 800 px tall photo gives an 800 x 800 PNG. Nothing is upscaled.

faqs.q: Rounded square vs circle — which for profile pictures?
faqs.a: Circles for personal avatars (WhatsApp, social profiles). Rounded squares for app icons and brand marks, where the fuller shape reads better at small sizes.

faqs.q: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Clipping runs on a canvas in your browser. Your photo never leaves your device.
